name: PKU-Market-Phone: Smartphone Screen Surface Defect Dataset
description: Smartphone screen glass surface defect segmentation dataset collected with an industrial camera at 1920x1080 resolution by Peking University Shenzhen Graduate School. Comprises 1,200 images evenly distributed across three surface defect classes (oil stains: 400, scratches: 400, spots: 400) with pixel-precise PASCAL VOC ground truth segmentation masks for industrial automated optical inspection benchmarking.
